  | n+1, m => plus1156 n m + 1

  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [plus1156, ih]

  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [plus1156, ih]
theorem plus1156_comm (n m : Nat) : plus1156 n m = plus1156 m n :=
A: by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [plus1156, plus1156_zero_right]
  | succ k ih => simp [plus1156, ih, plus1156_succ_right]
